context: M15 o6. The ice house, W 37th St & Tenth. Steam off the blocks. A foreman with a ledger and a smile.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: My friend. I need all the ice you have. All of it.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Three hundred, cash, and your wife gets a fox stole in October. Wholesale.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Five minutes ago I was at a banquet. Now I'm buying ice. America.
